game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage, a half-collapsed passage: the lantern keeper must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Door Defense: Push to repair the lantern post while the while-loop condition stays true and glow-eyed lurkers keep attacking.
theme: Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage: a half-collapsed passage
core_gameplay_loop: In Collapsed Passage, repeat each round: Push to repair the lantern post while the while-loop condition stays true and glow-eyed lurkers keep attacking. Each round, glow-eyed lurkers strike the lantern post, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the door_health value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the lantern post from glow-eyed lurkers in Collapsed Passage: keep the door_health meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 63-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: door_health drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 63-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Door Defense
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Door Defense' (Week 4 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Collapsed Passage'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how door_health changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Collapsed Passage.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 63 seconds while door_health > 0.
